title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Transfer Amount Bands and Surcharges
content:
Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — amount-band surcharge on next-business-day transfers to a bank account.

The bank band surcharge adds to the fee charged **0.25** for a bank transfer of 100.01 to 250.00 and **0.75** for one of 250.01 to 500.00; a bank transfer of 100.00 or less carries no surcharge.

| Bank transfer amount | Surcharge added |
|---|---|
| 100.00 USD or less | none |
| 100.01 to 250.00 USD | 0.25 USD |
| 250.01 to 500.00 USD | 0.75 USD |

The amount read is the amount of the transfer the fee prices.

*Boundaries (hypothetical):* 100.00 USD carries none and 100.01 USD carries 0.25 USD; 250.00 USD carries 0.25 USD and 250.01 USD carries 0.75 USD.
